translations.web: He saw heaven opened and a certain container descending to him, like a great sheet let down by four corners on the earth,
translations.bsb: He saw heaven open and something like a large sheet being let down to earth by its four corners.
translations.kjv: And saw heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending unto him, as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners, and let down to the earth:
